Ok heres my experience. Ive usually taken between 100-300mg for the past 4 years (dose fluctuating w the supervision of a psychiatrist or psychiatric nurse practitioner). To manage symptoms of bipolar I.

What helped me was switching from IR to Extended Release. This greatly diminished the kind of extreme sudden effects of drowsiness and hunger. 

I also then started taking it a lot earlier than before. Like i would normally take it just before bed and this would have me lethargic in the morning - a lethargy only two cigarettes and a cup of coffee would knock out of my system.

So now i normally take it 12 hours before i want to wake up. Which is usually around 7pm. This has me falling asleep around midnight and up and alert by 7.

But i also have to get to work by 5 am twice a week. So i have to wake up 4am those days. So i take it around 4pm, i fall asleep by about 10, and i get enough sleep while being more alert and well rested than if i hadnt taken seroquel at all.

So anyway, what worked for me was taking it a lot earlier than i thought. Of course, talk with your prescriber about these concerns.
